subject: Solstice Bank: request for BCP & cryptographic key access evidence
messages:
From: Owen Park <owen.park@solsticebank.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@solsticebank.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: BCP evidence & KMS access log request

Chloe —

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our procurement compliance review we need a short package showing Redwood's business continuity artifacts focused on two items: (1) recent RTO/RPO test results and (2) cryptographic key management access history for the KMS used in production (audit snapshot).

Specifically can you provide: 
- a one-page summary of the latest RTO/RPO exercise (dates, failover time observed, any gaps);
- the KMS access log snapshot for admin/root key rotations for the last 90 days (redact user email addresses if needed, but include timestamps and operation types);
- any runbooks or call trees used during the drill.

We're looking to bundle this into our SOC 2 evidence folder and would appreciate a response by end of week. If any items can't be shared verbatim please indicate redaction/compensating control.

Owen
Owen Park
Senior InfoSec Analyst — Solstice Bank
ow@solsticebank.com

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Owen Park <owen.park@solsticebank.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BCP evidence & KMS access log request

Owen —

Thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you requested. High-level plan: 

1) Attachments we can share now (PDF/XLSX/JSON stubs): BCP playbook excerpt, RTO/RPO stress test summary, and a sanitized KMS access log snapshot.
2) For raw KMS logs that include principal identifiers we'll provide a redacted JSON export and an accompanying attest statement describing retention and access controls.
3) We'll also include a short runbook excerpt (call tree & escalation matrix).

I'll loop in Dev for the technical export and Vivek for any contract/SLA commentary. If you need the logs in a signed bundle let us know and we can push via the shared Drive link (see below).

Deliverables (ETA: 48 hours):
- BCP_Playbook_v2.pdf (excerpt)
- RTO_RPO_Stress_Test_Summary_Q3_2026.xlsx
- kms_access_log_snapshot_20260901.json (redacted)
- evidence_delivery_manifest.txt (manifest + redaction notes)

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSolsticeEvidence

Best,
Chloe Martin
Manager, Customer Security & Trust
Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Owen Park <owen.park@solsticebank.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BCP evidence & KMS access log request

Owen / Chloe —

Attached are the technical exports per Chloe's notes. A couple of implementation notes: 
- kms_access_log_snapshot_20260901.json: this is a filtered export from our KMS telemetry pipeline showing key rotation and admin-level access events. We have redacted PII for compliance; the "principal_id" field is replaced with an internal hash but timestamps and operation fields (RotateKey, DisableKey, RevokeGrant) are intact.
- Logs are retained for 12 months in our audit archive (immutable storage w/hashed digests).
- If you need a signed MD5/SHA256 digest for the JSON snapshot we can produce one and add it to the manifest.

Attachment stubs included: (BCP_Playbook_v2.pdf), (RTO_RPO_Stress_Test_Summary_Q3_2026.xlsx), (kms_access_log_snapshot_20260901.json), (evidence_delivery_manifest.txt)

Date: 2026-09-22T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BCP evidence & KMS access log request

Owen / Maria —

Following up — we've uploaded the artifacts to the shared Drive folder. A few items to note from the RTO/RPO summary: 
- Drill date: 2026-09-15 (multi-AZ failover). Observed cold-start RTO to healthy regional pool: 4m 48s. RPO observed: ~90s for session cache warm-up.
- Known gap: persistent-local cache population lag under extreme connection loss; mitigation listed in playbook (prefetch + KV warm-up on rollout).
- The RTO/RPO spreadsheet includes the scenario matrix and time series traces for the primary metric windows.

For the KMS snapshot we have: sanitized event list + manifest with SHA256 digests. If you need the raw, unsanitized export we will require an NDA amendment or a controlled review session.

Drive link again: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cSolsticeEvidence

Can you confirm receipt and whether you need the signed digest attached to the manifest? If you're good with what's provided we'll mark the request as closed in our tracker.

Thanks,
Chloe

From: Owen Park <owen.park@solsticebank.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@solsticebank.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-23T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BCP evidence & KMS access log request

Chloe / team —

Received and reviewed. The artifacts look good and the redaction approach is acceptable for our SOC 2 pack. Please add the SHA256 digest to the manifest for chain-of-custody. Also a quick ask: can you add a one-line note in the manifest describing the retention policy for raw KMS logs and the process to request a restricted review (NDA amendment contact)?

Once those two small items are appended we'll close this item on our side. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Owen
